message:
1 text nodes carry a string written into the template:
      libs/components/widget/src/widget.html:32: "Delete {{…}} rows"
description: Words written into a text node around an interpolation: the node is no text the parser makes but an interpolation, and its words are its `strings`, which the expression visitor never hands on. Point 3 reads them as a text node's text, the expression standing in as `{{…}}`, and trims the node's white space as it trims a text's (measured: drawn "Delete 0 rows").
